# Alvin Aaron

Alvin Aaron has participated in 2 elections since 2002:

- [**2008 St Helier Connétable Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/alvin-aaron#e9)

  Not elected.
- [**2016 Senator By-Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/alvin-aaron#e22)

  Not elected.

  - [2016 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2016/alvin-aaron/)
  - [2016 SOS Jersey Q&A](http://sosjersey.co.uk/jerseys-senatorial-by-election-2016-qs-as/)
  - [2016 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cQRfnfeDTYk)

## Election History

### 2008 St Helier Connétable Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [St Helier](https://flow.je/elections/st-helier) (1 seat), 9th January 2008.

**Alvin Aaron was not elected**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Simon Crowcroft](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/simon-crowcroft)** |  | 2,317 | 89.7% |
| 2 | Alvin Aaron | [Jersey Democratic Alliance](https://flow.je/elections/parties/jersey-democratic-alliance) | 253 | 9.8% |
| 3 | ~~[Darius Pearce](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/darius-pearce)~~ |  | Withdrew |  |

2,582 votes (inc. 12 spoilt papers)

13,589 registered voters

= 19% turnout

_Registered voters estimated._

### 2016 Senator By-Election

Following the resignation of [Zoe Cameron](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/zoe-cameron) on 12th July 2016, the Royal Court called a senatorial by-election (1 seat), 7th September 2016.

**Alvin Aaron was not elected**.

| 3 | [Christian May](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/christian-may) |  | 2,018 | 16.4% |

| 6 | [Guy de Faye](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/guy-de-faye) |  | 254 | 2.1% |
| 7 | [Mary O’Keeffe](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mary-okeeffe) |  | 246 | 2% |
